title: 1 Corinthians
author: Paul the apostle.
historicalSetting: Paul addresses division, immorality, worship disorder, spiritual gifts, love, and resurrection hope.
keyVerse: 1 Corinthians 2:2 — "For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ, and him crucified."
christFocus: First Corinthians calls the church back to Christ crucified as the wisdom and power of God, shaping holiness, love, worship, and resurrection hope.
